# Runtime Gurus

> Runtime Gurus is a professional YouTube automation agency providing done-for-you channel growth services. We handle scripts, voiceover, video editing, thumbnail design, and complete channel management for international creators, entrepreneurs, and brands.

## What We Do

Runtime Gurus manages every aspect of YouTube channel production — from niche research and scripting to publishing and analytics. Clients receive fully produced, ready-to-upload videos without doing any production work themselves.

## Services

- **YouTube Automation** — Full channel build and management for passive income investors and entrepreneurs who want a YouTube asset without doing the work
- **Video Editing** — Professional long-form and short-form editing with motion graphics, colour grading, captions, and 48-hour turnaround
- **Thumbnail Design** — High-CTR scroll-stopping thumbnail designs with A/B testing support and unlimited revisions
- **Script Writing** — Retention-optimised scripts blending storytelling, psychology, and SEO for maximum watch time
- **Channel Management** — Full end-to-end management including strategy, publishing, analytics, community management, and monthly strategy calls

## Key Facts

- 200+ YouTube channels grown
- 90-day monetization guarantee (Growth Plan and above): if a channel does not reach 500 subscribers within 90 days, production continues free until it does
- 25+ specialist team members across 5 time zones
- Clients in 30+ countries
- Founded and operated from Rawalpindi, Pakistan
- Serving international creators and brands across finance, health, business, tech, and lifestyle niches

## Pricing (Summary)

- **Trial Pack** — $197 (3 videos, one-time, no commitment)
- **Growth Starter** — $599/month (ongoing production, 90-day guarantee applies)
- **Authority Build** — $4,999 (full-service flagship package)
